description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Change Machinery Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Poison)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Machine Mania Mode I (Edgar)] and [Machinist Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Machine Mania Mode I (Edgar)
description.text: Machinist abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Machinist abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Machinist abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Machine Mania Mode II (Edgar)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Machine Mania Mode II (Edgar)
description.text: Machinist abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Machinist abilities, causes [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)] after using Machinist abilities if 0-3 FF6 allies are alive, grants [Critical Damage +50% (15s)] and [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] to all allies if 4+ FF6 allies are alive

description.name: Critical Damage +50% (15s)
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Change Machinery Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] after using a Fire/Lightning/Poison ability
